description: This file defines the PathProcessorLanguage class which implements inbound and outbound path processing for language path alias lookups in Drupal. It manages language negotiation, path processing, and configuration for multilingual sites.

classes.name: PathProcessorLanguage
classes.description: Implements path processing for language alias lookups, handling inbound and outbound path modifications based on site language settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies including config, language manager, negotiator, current user, and config subscriber.

methods.name: processInbound
methods.description: Processes inbound paths, applying language path processing.

methods.name: processOutbound
methods.description: Processes outbound paths, applying language path processing and handling multilingual settings.

methods.name: initProcessors
methods.description: Initializes path processors based on language negotiation methods and sorts them by weight.

methods.name: initConfigSubscriber
methods.description: Injects the path processor into the configuration event subscriber.
